title: Scordelis-Lo roof
description: Cylindrical roof quarter model; radius 25, full length 50, thickness 0.25; E=4.32e8, nu=0.0.
geometry: 25 nodes; 16 elements. Cylindrical roof quarter model; radius 25, full length 50, thickness 0.25; E=4.32e8, nu=0.0.
material: E=4.32e+08, nu=0; density=1; shell thickness=0.25. Consistent benchmark units; displacements in deck length unit, forces in deck force unit, stress in force/length^2
boundary_conditions: Rigid end diaphragm and quarter-symmetry constraints; uniform vertical load 90 per unit surface area.
loading: Uniform downward load 90 per unit shell area: density=1, thickness=0.25 and gravity=360 in -Z.

references.citation: MacNeal, R.H.; Harder, R.L. (1985). A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy. Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1, 3-20.
Ko, Y.; Lee, Y.; Lee, P.-S.; Bathe, K.-J. (2017). Performance of the MITC3+ and MITC4+ shell elements in widely-used benchmark problems. Computers & Structures 193, 187-206.

observations: The figure shows the finest qualified companion; the table retains the supplied benchmark and available refinements. Each field dataset and binary file has its own input hash and run receipt.
limits: Linear elasticity and small-displacement equilibrium or linearized bifurcation/modal analysis; this is computational verification, not a material-test validation.
figure_caption: Recorded JFEM result; deformation is amplified, mode amplitudes/signs arbitrary. Green triangles mark constrained nodes; magenta arrows mark available point loads. Finest companion shown.
